item.title: Country music icon Dolly Parton passes away at 80 after short cancer fight
item.description: The singer, songwriter, and philanthropist had a career spanning over six decades.

item.title: USS Abraham Lincoln to make brief stop in Thailand after lengthy deployment
item.description: The U.S. aircraft carrier will pause in Thailand en route home following an exhausting Middle East deployment.

item.title: Iran and Oman move toward Strait of Hormuz reopening plan; Tehran demands U.S. lift blockade
item.description: The neighboring nations discussed a proposal to temporarily reopen the vital waterway and clear mines, contingent on U.S. actions.
